title: Pen assembly
summary: Put together a retractable gel pen from its three parts.

steps.title: Lay out the parts
steps.instruction: Put the three pen parts on the table in front of you and look at them.
steps.hint: Each part gets a checkmark once the headset recognizes it.

steps.title: Insert the ink refill
steps.instruction: Slide the ink refill into the tip housing, writing tip first, until the tip pokes out of the small hole at the end.
steps.hint: The black writing end goes in first. The clear tube with the yellow band sticks out the back.

steps.title: Attach the click housing
steps.instruction: Slide the clear click housing over the refill and twist it onto the tip housing until it's snug.
steps.hint: The clip and click button end faces away from the tip.

steps.title: Test the pen
steps.instruction: Click the button on top. The tip should come out, and go back in when you click again.
steps.hint: If the tip doesn't come out, the refill may be in backwards. Go back a step.
